title: Smallest Index With Digit Sum Equal to Index
summary: Given an integer array nums, find the smallest index i where the sum of the digits of nums[i] equals i.
statement: Given an integer array nums, find the smallest index i where the sum of the digits of nums[i] equals i. If no such index exists, return -1.
constraints: For each array position i, sum the decimal digits of nums[i].
Return the smallest index whose digit sum equals i.
hints: Compute the decimal digit sum of the current value.
Return immediately on equality with the index.
Left-to-right early return guarantees the smallest qualifying index.
editorial: Left-to-right early return guarantees the smallest qualifying index.

tests.explanation: At index two, value two has digit sum two; earlier indices do not match.
Index zero matches the digit sum of zero, so it is returned immediately.
